# Shared coordination file (machine-wide)

## Summary
Move coordination.json and its lock to the machine dir; entries carry worklogRoot so all instances read/write the same file. Retain tmp+rename atomic write, O_CREAT|O_EXCL lock, and stale-entry pruning.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] One shared coordination dir: A second herdr instance opened on a *different* worklog joins the same coordination file; the file contains entries with different `worklogRoot`s. — headless test with two temp worklog roots proves shared file (covers parent AC1)
- [ ] Fail-safe: unreadable/corrupt coordination file returns null and the tick skips dispatch (never throws or drops another instance's entry)
- [ ] Lock serializes concurrent read-modify-write; atomic tmp+rename prevents half-written JSON
- [ ] worklogRoot field is the worklog root (parent of .worklog), backward compat with legacy directory field; build green

## Minimal Implementation
- Update packages/herdr/src/coordination.ts path resolution to use getMachineCoordinationDir() (F1)
- Rename/retain directory -> worklogRoot (keep directory as alias for compat); entries {instanceId, workItemId, worklogRoot/directory, assignedAt, lastUpdated}
- Update pruneStaleEntries to run against machine file
- Headless test packages/herdr/tests/coordination-machine.test.ts

## Dependencies
- Depends on WL-0MTII3QI9001GUUK (machine dir resolver)

## Deliverables
- Updated coordination.ts + headless test + code comments

**Key Files:**
- `packages/herdr/src/coordination.ts`
- `packages/herdr/tests/coordination-machine.test.ts`
